info.name: Huckleberry Server
info.description:
API collection for all Huckleberry Server endpoints.

Variables:
- `BASE_URL`: e.g. http://localhost:3000
- `devToken`: DEV_TOKEN value (DomoAuthGuard endpoints)
- `hbSession`: hb_session cookie value (HuckleberryAuthGuard endpoints)
- `csrfToken`: csrf_token cookie value
- `adminApiKey`: ADMIN_API_KEY env value

item.name: Auth
item.description: HuckleberryAuthGuard. Public endpoints use no auth; protected endpoints require hb_session + csrf_token cookies.

request.description: Initiate signup flow. Returns 202 regardless of whether the email exists (existence-oracle protection).
Request a magic link for sign-in. Returns 202.
Exchange magic-link token. Sets hb_session and csrf_token cookies.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Requires x-admin-api-key header. Not under /api prefix.

request.description: Provision a new user and Domo instance.

item.name: Domo Linkage
item.description: HuckleberryAuthGuard. Links a Domo instance to the current user.

request.description: Start PKCE OAuth flow. Returns { authorizeUrl }.
OAuth callback — exchanges code for tokens and redirects.
Returns active Domo link for the current user.

item.name: Agents
item.description: DomoAuthGuard — pass x-domo-developer-token or x-domo-embedded-security header.
